correctness.rationale: The letterwise free C_p-action commutes with H and permutes its word classes. Each nontrivial fixed class has cardinality multiple p and contributes at least p-1 to the deficit, while every free class orbit contributes a multiple p. A fixed class forces equal letter multiplicities around every p-cycle and hence p|n; this yields the length congruence and equality classification. The two periodic examples realize p-1 at length p and p at n=2. Independent finite tests enumerated all invariant sets/position subgroups for (p,n)=(3,2),(3,3),(5,2),(7,2) and verified examples. These tests are not a proof of arbitrary n or H.
residual_risks: Computational bounded checks are not proofs for infinite or continuum assertions; critical analytic steps were reconstructed.
